line: Shit, on a fuck nigga (Uh huh), I do that, Off-White sneaks cost two racks (Two racks yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah)
vault_lines: I hit the strip club and spent a dub, but you knew that
meaning:
While further exclaiming that he spends his money in the strip club, G Herbo chooses to brag about the expensive Off-White shoes that he’s bought, most likely from the Off-White collaborations with Nike, and resell at that price. Off-White being the trendy and luxurious Italian fashion brand by Virgil Abloh.



Ironically, “WWYA” producer Charlie Heat’s success can be traced back to Virgil. In a 2016 interview with Complex, the Heater says that his G.O.O.D. Music signing happened after Virgil played songs for Kanye West that Charlie had produced for Lil Uzi Vert. This led to Kanye immediately flying Charlie out to LA, and then ended up signing him as a producer, as well as later showcasing him within the tracklisting of The Life of Pablo on “Facts,” the Charlie Heat Version that is.
